notes: Default kill switch prevents every live call. Meta access and a positive CLOUD_BUDGET_USD are separate requirements.
maxCompletionTokens is the total visible-plus-reasoning completion budget. Responses serializes it as max_output_tokens; chat completions would use max_completion_tokens.
Unit prices and input byte/framing upper bound are explicit planning assumptions, not a verified provider invoice guarantee.
Unknown dispatch outcomes retain their entire reservation. Automatic SDK retries are disabled.

HANDOFF_LIVE_RUN_ID must be set by the operator, or supplied by a trusted server caller. All questions in one authorized run share this ledger; question trace UUIDs never select or reset a budget. Browser input cannot set a live run ID.
